correctness.rationale: Exact step substitution produces the rational Green generating function. Its cubic discriminant is strictly negative for every positive parameter. The unique real root R is monotone under s=10R^3/(15R^2-6R+1), and Vieta gives |u|^2=R^2/(15R^2-6R+1). The crossing at R=2/5 is μ=15/16. The positive real residue dominates below; oscillatory complex residues dominate above. At equality, the exact amplitude ratio (2|B|/A)^2=20/17>1 and irrational phase cosθ=7/10 prove infinitely many signs of each kind. G6(187/200) is an exact negative rational below the cutoff. All roots have modulus <1, ensuring absolute summability and the strict normalized absolute-convolution gain. The independent symbolic script reproduces critical exact identities; finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Coefficientwise positivity and bounded-input amplification are natural strong-stability diagnostics for the optimized BDFL three-step scalar response. This exact method-specific boundary (15/16 rather than BDF2’s 1/2) and a nonempty transient-negative but eventually-positive phase distinguish asymptotic mode decay from finite-step monotonicity and provide a sharp verifiable stress benchmark, rather than an arbitrary index test.
